disposition_mapping.rationale: Close calendar initiation and cutoff enforcement persist but are restructured onto an orchestration platform with real-time status and automated posting locks, preserving IAS 1 cutoff discipline.

Journal preparation is split by nature: mechanical, template-driven accruals and prepayment releases are automated with exception review (TS-02), while estimation-based entries requiring judgment and documented basis (IAS 8, IAS 2, IFRS 9) remain a distinct accountable human activity (TS-03), preserving the accrual mechanism and estimate accountability.
Allocation processing persists but is restructured around an automated allocation engine with human validation of bases and exceptions.

Intercompany processing is preserved but split into automated high-volume rule-based matching (TS-05) and human-led exception resolution and elimination preparation (TS-06), maintaining full identification and elimination of intragroup positions per IFRS 10 as required by R2R-R-02.

GL and balance-sheet reconciliation is preserved as required by R2R-R-01, restructured into continuous, risk-based reconciliation with automated certification of low-risk accounts and retained human certification with evidence for higher-risk accounts, preserving the IAS 1 evidential trail.

Trial balance and consolidation persist, restructured around an automated consolidation engine that still performs mandatory FX translation (IAS 21) and full intragroup elimination (IFRS 10) with human validation.

Management review and adjustment survives essentially unchanged in substance, satisfying R2R-R-07, and remains performed by the Controller, an actor distinct from journal preparers (TS-02/TS-03), satisfying the segregation required by R2R-R-05.

The reporting package function survives as required by R2R-R-06, restructured to use automated compilation tooling, and remains sequenced after reconciliation (TS-07) and management review (TS-09) per R2R-R-03 and R2R-R-04.

steps.description: Operate a system-enforced close calendar with real-time subledger status monitoring (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll); apply automated posting locks at cutoff; publish and track the close checklist with owners, deadlines and live completion status; confirm data readiness for journal preparation. Preserves period cutoff discipline (IAS 1) while replacing manual distribution with an orchestration platform.
inputs: Subledger status feeds (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll)
steps.name: Continuous close orchestration and cutoff control
outputs: Live close checklist with status tracking

steps.description: System-generated posting of recurring accruals from templates and schedules and prepayment releases per amortisation schedules, with the GL accountant reviewing system-flagged exceptions and reclassification/error-correction entries before release. Preserves the accrual basis (IAS 1/8) and the error-correction path (IAS 8) while automating the mechanical portion of journal preparation.
steps.name: Automated recurring and template-driven journal posting

steps.description: Prepare provisions and estimates requiring judgment and documented basis (bad debt/expected credit loss, inventory NRV write-downs, litigation reserves) with supporting evidence attached for each estimate, per IAS 8 and IAS 2/IFRS 9 requirements. Distinct from the automated stream and from management review to preserve segregation of duties.
steps.name: Estimation and judgment-based journal preparation
outputs: Estimation journals posted with documented basis and evidence

steps.description: System executes cost and overhead allocations per the allocation model (shared-service recharges, corporate overhead distribution, intercompany management fees); GL accountant validates allocation bases and approves posting, with exceptions routed for investigation.
steps.name: Automated allocations engine with validation

steps.description: Rule-based, high-volume automated matching of intercompany balances across entities (AR/AP mirror accounts, loans, recharges) using a matching engine; matched items settle automatically; unmatched items are flagged for exception handling. Preserves the ability to identify intragroup positions in full per IFRS 10.
steps.name: Automated intercompany matching

steps.description: Investigate and resolve flagged mismatches through inter-entity coordination and judgment; process settlements and netting for resolved items; prepare elimination entries for consolidation, ensuring full identification and elimination of intragroup balances and unrealised profit per IFRS 10.
steps.name: Intercompany exception resolution and elimination preparation

steps.description: Reconcile GL accounts to subledgers, bank statements and supporting schedules on a continuous basis per the reconciliation policy; low-risk, high-confidence-match accounts are auto-certified by the reconciliation platform, while accounts risk-rated as medium/high require accountant review, certification with supporting evidence, and reviewer sign-off; unreconciled items are flagged and aged for resolution. Preserves the evidential trail required by IAS 1 and the error-correction path of IAS 8.
steps.name: Continuous risk-based GL and balance-sheet reconciliation
outputs: Reconciliations auto-certified (low risk) or certified with evidence (medium/high risk)

steps.description: Prepare the trial balance; run automated consolidation across entities including currency translation at closing/spot rates (IAS 21), application of prepared elimination entries and profit eliminations (IFRS 10), and minority-interest processing; validate consolidated balances against entity submissions and surface exchange differences distinctly rather than netting them.
steps.name: Trial balance, automated consolidation and elimination processing

steps.description: Review draft consolidated results against expectations and prior period; investigate anomalies; determine, document and post management adjustments; sign off account-level results for reporting. Performed by an actor independent of journal preparation (TS-02/TS-03) to preserve segregation of duties.
steps.name: Management review and adjustments

steps.description: Compile the period-end reporting package using automated report generation drawing on signed-off consolidated results: financial statements, management commentary, variance schedules and KPI summaries; distribute to management and group per the reporting timetable, after reconciliation (TS-07) and management review (TS-09) are complete.
steps.name: Automated financial reporting package compilation and distribution
